# Conditional shared path rules

Before changing a file, match its repository-relative path against the patterns below and explicitly read every matching shared rule. These patterns are conditional; listing a rule does not apply it to unrelated files. Match the spelling and case of repository paths: `assets` and `Assets` describe different engine layouts, including on Windows.

`**` spans directories, `*` matches within a path segment, and braces list alternatives. All original patterns are preserved, including global file globs and ignored memory paths. Patterns do not select an engine or require creating their directories.

Apply the [Codex runtime translations](runtime.md) and applicable AGENTS.md instructions.
